children: Conference attendance at Mello2026 Investor event

PCI-PAL plc (AIM: PCIP), the global cloud provider of secure payments and experiences across human and AI-driven business communications environments, announces that the Company will be presenting and exhibiting at the Mello2026 investor event on Tuesday 17 November, which will be held at The Clayton Hotel & Conference Centre, Chiswick High Road, London, W4 5RY.

James Barham, CEO, and Mufti Monim, CTO, will be presenting at 12.25pm and 14:25pm on the day, providing an overview of the Company and strategy. No new material information on the Company’s financial performance or current trading will be disclosed at this investor event. For further information and tickets (use code SHAREML25 for 25% off ticket price), please visit the event website at https://www.melloevents.com/mellolondon2026.
Cavendish Capital Markets Limited (Nominated Adviser and Broker)
Marc Milmo / Fergus Sullivan / Finn Gordon (Corporate Finance)

PCI Pal is the trusted transaction layer powering secure human and AI-driven payments and experiences across business communications worldwide. Its cloud-native, platform-agnostic solutions enable organisations to take payments and protect sensitive data securely, support compliance, and reduce the risks associated with data loss across voice and digital conversations. Delivered through a scalable global cloud platform and a market-leading partner ecosystem, PCI Pal’s solutions are integrated, embedded, and resold by leading business communications vendors and payment service providers.
For more information visit www.pcipal.com or follow the team on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/pci-pal/
